charts.title: K2-136 d: orbits around K2-136
charts.description: The orbits of K2-136's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-136 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mayo et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..235M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MAYO_ET_AL_2023): P 25.575 d

charts.title: K2-136 d: its transit
charts.description: K2-136 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (44, 70, 71) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 18310799, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 440 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 544 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 440 min early; 12-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 181 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
